heading: **13 November 2025**
body:
***QC for NCAP-SELEX cycle 1***

Concentration measurements using (Qubit):

lig147 PCR1 \- 3.14 ng/uL (A4)

ligN40 PCR1 \- 6.96 ng/uL (A4)

*A run of the PCR1 products from well P23 for both cases showed significant DNA profiles. For N40 products, the expected band size as well as some higher size products were also seen.*

lig147 PCR2 \- 2.5 ng/uL (P23)

ligN40 PCR2 \- 4.96 ng/uL (P23)

Some sample had been collected after SBP-bead enrichment & post Ni-bead enrichment for samples pooled from wells P22, P24 → these wells used nucleosome but no TF. These were measured using Qubit & expected trends are seen.

lig147-nuc: 0.08 ng/uL

ligN40-nuc: 0.78 ng/uL

lig147-nuc+TF: no DNA

ligN40-nuc+TF: no DNA

MNase treatment of lig147-nuc & ligN40-nuc:

i. lig147 (50 ng) \+ 5 uL Buffer \+ 0.25 uL rAlbumin \+ 1 uL dil-MNase 

ii. ligN40 (50 ng) \+ 5 uL Buffer \+ 0.25 uL rAlbumin \+ 1 uL dil-MNase

iii. lig147-nuc \+ 5 uL Buffer \+ 0.25 uL rAlbumin \+ 1 uL dil-MNase

iv. ligN40-nuc \+ 5 uL Buffer \+ 0.25 uL rAlbumin \+ 1 uL dil-MNase

v. lig147-nuc+TF \+ 5 uL Buffer \+ 0.25 uL rAlbumin \+ 1 uL dil-MNase

vi. ligN40-nuc+TF \+ 5 uL Buffer \+ 0.25 uL rAlbumin \+ 1 uL dil-MNase

Incubate at 37 C, 10 mins and then add 1.1 uL 0.5 M EGTA. Run this on a 0.5% agarose gel and stain with SYBR Green.

Run 1 uL each of PCR1 & PCR2 products (P23) on the same gel for staining.

***Hia5 treatment for long-read samples***

D8-h: 113 ng

lig20K-h: 266 ng

lig50K-h: 176 ng

293T-20K-h: 189 ng

GP5d-20K-h: 52 ng

Set up reactions for lig20K-h (2), lig50K-h (1), 293T-20K-h (1) & 5 reactions for GP5d-20K-h (400 ng each).

*lig20K*

R1X2: 400 ng DNA \+ Hia5 buffer \+ 0.5 uL Hia5 \+ 0.5 uL SAM

*lig50K*

R2: 400 ng DNA \+ Hia5 buffer \+ 0.5 uL Hia5 \+ 0.5 uL SAM

*293T-20K*

R3: 400 ng DNA \+ Hia5 buffer \+ 0.5 uL Hia5 \+ 0.5 uL SAM

*GP5d-20K*

R4X5: 400 ng DNA \+ Hia5 buffer \+ 0.5 uL Hia5 \+ 0.5 uL SAM
title: QC for NCAP-SELEX cycle 1
